_readme: Industry rewrites for events whose MECHANICS are universal but whose FICTION is not.
Keyed by event id, then by industry code. Each string replaces GameEvent.text
wholesale for a player in that industry — components/DecisionSheet.tsx already
reads `event.reskins?.[industry] ?? event.text`, so nothing downstream changes.
WHY THIS FILE EXISTS SEPARATELY: data/sections/*.json is protected authored
content. scripts/parse-events.mjs merges this overlay onto the base events at
build time, so every section file stays byte-identical and the flavour can be
RULES FOR ADDING TO THIS FILE
1. Never change what the situation MEANS. The choices are shared across all
twelve industries and their outcomes are unchanged — a rewrite that shifts
the problem makes the choices answer a different question.
2. Preserve every figure the choices depend on. 'raises prices 18%' stays 18%.
Events whose text carries numbers the choice labels lean on (E-MKT-002's
three 2S doors, E-FIN-003's 6S invoice) are deliberately NOT reskinned.
3. Real words only (Brand Law 6). A mill, a cut ticket, a purchase order, a
term, a batch. No invented units.
4. Same register as the base text: terse, second person, dry, present tense.
